Black Elie - former Obliviate, former Sisterhood Matriarch, and a Nectar-long throughout - is behind the cult called the Ivory Dawn. She intends to render Yvette Southey to Ys. She insists this will serve the so-called 'Bird' cause - the cause of stability.
Black Elie has taken Yvette to Ys, to aid their schemes. If she was right, their schemes might include the protection of Brancrug, though not the wider continent.
Black Elie's schemes are finished. Perhaps she is too. But she's always been a survivor.

Did anyone actually benefit from following an oracle's advice? We're probably better off without.
Echidna will become Yvette's keeper. Rowena is no longer a problem for Yvette; Ys may be a problem for everyone else.

Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. Now that Kitling Ripe's attention has been drawn to these tasty hybrid treats, the scheme is doomed.

Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close, but with Father Stanislav's help - and perhaps that of Hush House - the scheme will continue.

Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close, but with Father Stanislav's help, the scheme will continue. For now, it remains in hibernation at Hush House.

Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close. With Father Stanislav's help the scheme might continue, but Hush House will not host it.

Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp has forced her to close, but she may continue somewhere else…
Liselotte has been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind at the Lyterion. Is that bad?
Lost Horizon
Lt Moore has made Abecassis, the altered labhite, a prisoner of the Labyrinth. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna has been angered by his capture.
Lucia the Eyeless might work to free poor Ghirbi - even if that tests her loyalties to the Meniscate.
Lucia the Eyeless will parley with the Chandler. Perhaps she'll alter her loyalties; perhaps the Chandler will free poor Ghirbi. There will be changes. But surely the Chancel will not be compromised?
Lucia the Eyeless will remain a loyal Name of the Meniscate, despite her disquiet over the treatment of her fellow name, Ghirbi.
Lucia the Eyeless, name of the Meniscate, has taken to gifting mortals with sight - even though that may not be the wish of the Meniscate.
Medusa has abandoned her Stonely past, and become something more human - or something more mortal? That remains to be seen.
Medusa has acknowledged her nature, and rejoined the Carapace Cross.
Medusa has changed; she has set aside the stone of her long sin; she has entered History.
Medusa haunts the days, desperate for difference. What, then, is the answer to her riddle? How will she change? Sometimes, other notables besides the Librarian make determinations of their own…
Medusa passes from the world. There will be only six Ligeians… for a time.
Medusa's nature will become transparent for those with eyes to see. Perhaps, at last, she will be safe to look upon.
No news is good news. The matter is at an end as far as we're concerned.

The Librarian agreed to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Agdistis was grateful; but clearly disquieted, uncertain of what might come.
The Librarian agreed to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Ehsan's patient still dreams of the shapes in the clouds of the West…
The Librarian declined to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Agdistis seems content with that; perhaps even relieved.
The Librarian declined to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Apparently as a result, Ehsan's patient has finally found peace.

The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Arthur, for Arthur's imprisonment of the labhite Abecassis. Arthur is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Azita, for Azita's slaying of the labhite Abecassis. Azita is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Chaima, for Chaima's slaying of the labhite Abecassis. Chaima is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

The Légion du Seuil has crushed the Zurvanist splinter-sect that  was causing so much trouble. Order has been restored to the Bounds… and the Zurvanists remain faithful to the Lionsmith-Name that they follow.

The Légion du Seuil has retreated from a new little Threshold in the Bounds carved out by a Zurvanist splinter-sect. The Name called the 'Fourfold Lion' has his own domain now - it's not clear whether he remains faithful to the Lionsmith.
The Légion du Seuil is restoring order to the Bounds. The rebel Zurvanist splinter-sect that follows the 'Fourfold Lion' has grown desperate.

The Open Reverend has not been 'blessed' by any servant of the Mother of Ants or the Horned-Axe. What then has changed him? Douglas and Ehsan are both investigating.
The Open Reverend is becoming a 'strand' of the Excellency Gnathobasis, a Name of one of the gods-from-Nowhere. The Suppression Bureau must intervene.
The Open Reverend is no business of the House. Some things are better left alone.

The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. She has called on an old alliance: perhaps the Carapace Cross will tend a garden of those flowers in the fallen city of Miah.

The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. She hoped the Carapace Cross would tend a garden of those flowers in the fallen city of Miah: but they prefer to dwell there in peace, without risking Calyptra's anger.
The Vagabond, along with two other Hours, proposes to challenge Calyptra with a flower that is neither black nor white. To that end, she has called on an old alliance with the Carapace Cross…

The Wangle of the Crowd
The Zurvanist splinter-sect that follows the 'Fourfold Lion' has grown stronger. It may carve out its own little Threshold in the Bounds near Meshad.

The Zurvanist splinter-sect that was causing trouble in the Bounds has abruptly abandoned its oneirosecessionist ambitions… because, it seems, of the promises made to the 'Fourfold Lion' by emissaries of the Chandler.

The Zurvanist splinter-sect that was causing trouble in the Bounds has peacefully abandoned its oneirosecessionist ambitions… apparently because the Name called the 'Fourfold Lion' has renewed his devotion to the Lionsmith.
The altered labhite Abecassis is free in the world, for good or for ill.

The business at Gladwyn Lake was the work of the Haustorium - a noble institution that 'preserves what would not otherwise be preserved', or a 'creepy pack of Peruvian fungus-wizards', depending on preference. Intentionally or not, this has brought the Haustorium and the Suppression Bureau into a new alliance, to the great unhappiness of Connie Lee.
The business in Venice was the beginning of a serious disagreement between Madrugad and Moth - and their respective allies. This could be the beginning of something cataclysmic.
The democratisation of the Wangle has made it possible to loosen Calyptra's grip. This could end very messily.
The dreams that the wooden saint brings continue to propagate; but the dreamers now wake cheerful and refreshed.
The dreams that the wooden saint brings have been pent safely in the Mansus.
The labhite Abecassis is dead, slain by Azita in service to the Colonel. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna isn't impressed by Azita's intervention.
The labhite Abecassis is dead, slain by Chaima as an act of grim mercy. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna isn't impressed by Chaima's intervention.
The labhite Abecassis is seen no more. Most likely he's joined Echidna's retinue. Zachary remains.
The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was buried in the earth.
The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was burned in a fire.
The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was drowned in the river.
The miraculous wooden saint-image may well still retain all its miraculous properties, but we're finished with it.

The performance of the 'Invisible Opera' in Venice ended prematurely with a fire backstage and a murder in the ticket office. This is is the sort of thing that usually happens. But this time, also, a handful of audience members  are haunted now by dreams of black-and-white flowers - whose perfume follows them into the waking world...

The performance of the 'Invisible Opera' in Venice was successfully completed, with no known fatalities: a historical first. Even the notices were not uniformly terrible, despite the lighting difficulties that plunged the third act into darkness. But a handful of audience members are haunted now by dreams of black-and-white flowers - whose perfume follows them into the waking world...

The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg. I could inform on her to Oriflamme's, probably for a reward. I could promise her my silence, winning her loyalty to the Institute. Or I could forget the matter.
The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg… and now that Oriflamme's knows that, she'll be in trouble.
The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg… but her secret is safe.
The prowling emissary of Ys was returned to his home beyond the wave.

The seals on the Messenger's casket are cracking, and though he is not yet free, he is now sometimes seen in the world of images - unexpectedly in the background of photographs, flame-wreathed in dangerously inspired paintings.
The seals on the Messenger's casket are renewed. His image has vanished from the photographs where he was seen. Only one depiction remained, and that was committed to my care.

The solemnly named 'Wangle', by which mortals might win extra years of life despite the Madrugad's limits, has been quietly reproduced, and the technique promulgated underground by Arun Peel and his co-conspirators. This will be a source of quiet chaos.
The travelling-kinds of the Carapace Cross have alighted on the isles of the west. How have they changed those who were drawn to them?
The wooden saint is forgotten, and its inheritance will likely join it in the flames.
There has been a curious fad for new religious organisations recently… including an odd outfit that calls itself the Ivory Dawn.
This oracle was meant for Connie Lee - but Connie, disillusioned by the Affair of the Friar's Tapestry, has left the Bureau.
